run_metadata.coverage_summary: WebSearch-only discovery run. External WebFetch/egress remained blocked by the organisation egress proxy (EGRESS_BLOCKED, HTTP 403) again this run — reconfirmed with a live WebFetch of https://www.tenders.gov.au/atm (EGRESS_BLOCKED) while the proxy status endpoint reports healthy (enabled:true, bundleCoversEveryHost:true, recentRelayFailures empty). Per /root/.ccr/README.md a 403 from the proxy is a non-retryable organisation egress-policy denial, so no tender detail page or specification document could be opened directly. Every opportunity below is therefore captured from WebSearch only: existence / ID / open-status from the verifiable result-link <title> text (e.g. 'Current ATM View - <ID>: AusTender', treated as reliable), and any buyer / title / date / scope detail from WebSearch answer snippets (which summarise the target page and are treated as SNIPPET-DERIVED, not independently verified — flagged in each entry's notes and detail_source). Tier 1 Commonwealth (AusTender) and all eight state/territory portals were probed via search (NSW eTendering/buy.nsw, VIC Buying for Victoria, QLD QTenders/supply.qld, WA Tenders WA, SA Tenders SA, TAS Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL, ACT Tenders). AusTender surfaced buyer-originated Current-ATM notices not present in the routine's known dedup keys: HOMEAFFAIRS/2206/RFT (Home Affairs navigational-aids & mooring-equipment maintenance, NT), and a new set of AMSA regional Aids-to-Navigation maintenance RFTs (26AMSA059, 26AMSA060, 26AMSA064; companion to the previously-seen 26AMSA128). Tier 2 (Sydney Water, WaterNSW, VendorPanel councils) and Tier 3 (SAP Ariba Discovery, NBN Co, BHP/Rio/Fortescue-class buyers) were probed via search but returned only known portals or login-gated boards this run — no publicly-visible, verifiable, still-open corporate opportunity surfaced. Genuinely new buyer-originated sources identified: Camden Council (NSW local gov), Sunshine Coast Council public tenders (VendorPanel), Westport WA (infrastructure/port), and the AMSA aids-to-navigation tender page.
gaps: WebFetch egress fully blocked (EGRESS_BLOCKED / HTTP 403) for every external host this run — confirmed against https://www.tenders.gov.au/atm. No tender detail page or specification/RFT document could be opened, so all deliverables/requirements/evaluation-criteria fields are null unless summarised in a WebSearch snippet, and all snippet-derived detail is unverified.

AusTender current-ATM list, per-jurisdiction search endpoints, and per-tender detail pages were reachable only via WebSearch result titles/snippets, not by direct fetch; pagination could not be walked, so Tier 1 coverage is a sample of what surfaced in search, not exhaustive.

Camden Council tenders T022/2026, T024/2026, T033/2026, T034/2026 confirmed as current from the council's current-tenders page title text, but publish dates, closing dates, values and deliverables were not visible in snippets — left null (headline-level, pending detail).

AMSA regional AtoN RFTs 26AMSA059 and 26AMSA064 confirmed to exist as Current ATMs from result titles, but close dates and per-region scope were not returned in snippets — captured headline-level, pending detail.

Tier 3 corporate: SAP Ariba Discovery, NBN Co, Coles/Woolworths and mining-major (BHP/Rio/Fortescue) boards are login/registration-gated; no publicly-visible current RFx surfaced via WebSearch. Portals recorded in discovered_sources where new; no corporate opportunities fabricated. Invitation-only management-consultancy RFPs remain out of scope.
Other new AusTender ATM IDs seen in search titles but not examined this run (ATM_2026_6066, AACAP 2026-P04) — deferred to a future run.
AusTender ID 57097 (Defence/ASIO psychologist-services panel) surfaced but is stale (published 21-Nov-2025, closed 30-Jan-2026) — excluded as not open/recent.

tenders.category: Building construction and support and maintenance and repair services
tenders.description: AMSA seeks contractor(s) to deliver regional Aids to Navigation (AtoN) maintenance services across one or more regions, under a fixed-price arrangement for planned essential and minor corrective maintenance.

Tenderers may bid for one or more regions (including all regions); one contractor is selected per region and may win multiple regions. Bids accepted per region or for all regions; one contractor selected per region.
